hero.title:
Privacy is a

Human Right.
hero.subtitle: Professional software shouldn't require your identity. SafeTools was built to prove that you can have world-class tools without the surveillance.

pillars.title: 100% Offline Capable
pillars.desc: Once the tool is loaded, you can disconnect your internet. The engine is now entirely yours.

pillars.title: Zero Data Residency
pillars.desc: We own no databases for user content. Your files never touch a hard drive outside your own.

pillars.title: RAM-Only Compute
pillars.desc: All processing happens in high-speed, volatile memory. Closing the tab is equivalent to a secure wipe.

verification.title:
The 10-Second

Verification.
verification.subtitle: We don't ask for your trust. We provide the tools for you to verify our claims in seconds.

steps.title: Open any Tool
steps.desc: Select any image or PDF utility from the home page.

steps.title: Go Offline
steps.desc: Toggle your Airplane mode or disconnect your Ethernet.

steps.title: Process Files
steps.desc: Upload and process your file. You'll notice it works at native speed with zero network activity.

items.title: Zero Server Knowledge
items.desc: We don't just 'encrypt' your files; we never see them. Our servers only serve static code. Your data stays in your RAM, exactly where it belongs.

items.title: Advertising & Cookies
items.desc: To keep SafeTools free, we use third-party vendors like Google AdSense. These vendors use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to this and other sites. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings.

items.title: Ephemeral by Default
items.desc: Your data is processed in volatile memory. Once you close the tab, the state is wiped. There are no backups, because there is no storage.

items.title: Verified Isolation
items.desc: SafeTools uses the highest browser security headers (COOP/COEP) to ensure that your processing session is strictly isolated from other web content.

protection.title: Total Protection
protection.subtitle: We apply the same zero-compromise logic to every data type.

final.title:
The Internet

Should be Private.
final.subtitle: SafeTools is not just a product; it's a statement. In a world that wants to track every click, we provide a sanctuary of productivity. No accounts. No tracking. No compromise.

terms.title: Service <covenant>Covenant.</covenant>
terms.subtitle: Our terms are simple: Your device, your data, your control. We provide the tools; you provide the sovereignty.
terms.boundSubtitle: We apply the same zero-compromise logic to every engagement.

cta.title: Legal <consultation>Consultation</consultation>
cta.subtitle: For enterprise deployments or specialized security audits, our technical team is available for consultation.

sections.title: 1. The Local-First Covenant
sections.description: By using SafeTools, you understand and agree that this is a client-side execution platform. We provide the 'Architectural Blueprint' (the code), but the 'Construction' (data processing) happens entirely on your local hardware. We do not provide a hosting service for your data; we provide a local execution environment.

sections.title: 2. Absolute Data Sovereignty
sections.description: Your files remain your property and never leave your machine. SafeTools claims zero rights to your assets. Because we never see your data, we cannot fulfill 'Data Deletion' requestsas we have nothing to delete. You are the sole custodian of your digital assets.

sections.title: 3. Hardware Execution & Limits
sections.description: Processing heavy media consumes your local CPU, GPU, and RAM. Performance is dependent on your device's capabilities. SafeTools is not responsible for browser crashes, memory overflows, or thermal throttling resulting from intensive local processing.

sections.title: 4. No Persistence & Recovery
sections.description: This is a stateless application. We do not maintain user accounts, databases, or cloud storage. Once you close your browser tab, your progress is permanently lost. It is your responsibility to download your assets immediately after processing.

sections.title: 5. Security & Transparency
sections.description: We encourage the audit of our client-side logic. You are prohibited from using our tools for malicious purposes, including but not limited to: generating illegal content, unauthorized metadata injection, or attempting to reverse-engineer our engine logic.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.description: SafeTools is provided 'as-is'. We do not guarantee 100% accuracy in file conversion or metadata stripping. We are not liable for any data loss, corruption, or consequential damages arising from the use of our browser-local utilities.
